notes: §1985:VIII.2.6.2 prints the relative module's I-O-CONTROL paragraph: any number of RERUN ON file-name-1 or implementor-name-1 EVERY integer-1 RECORDS OF file-name-2, integer-2 CLOCK-UNITS or condition-name-1 clauses, any number of SAME [RECORD] AREA FOR clauses of two or more files, and one closing period; §1985:VIII.2.6.3 GR1 makes its RERUN "a subset of the RERUN clause for the Sequential I-O module". ioControlParagraph, rerunClause, rerunEvery and sameClause parse those forms with EVERY, OF, AREA and FOR as optional words, VisitRerunClause removes RERUN only from 2002, and BindIoControl hands the clauses to ScreenRerunClauses (the sequential clause's rules, which leave the relative subset its ON phrase: a RECORDS, CLOCK-UNITS or condition-name phrase with no ON is COBOL6530, END OF REEL of a relative file COBOL6529, a missing file-name-2 COBOL6496) and ScreenSameOperands (fewer than two files, or a name that is no file, COBOL2738); ScreenParagraphPeriods refuses a period between clauses or a missing closing one and VisitUnrecognizedClause any other word (APPLY COMMIT is COBOL0900 at 85). Probes at --std 85 accept every RERUN arm with SAME AREA and SAME RECORD AREA in either order under one period, and an empty paragraph; the witness writes SAME AREA FOR two relative files and runs.

next.reason: 1985: "RERUN ON { file-name-1 | implementor-name-1 } EVERY { integer-1 RECORDS OF file-name-2 | integer-2 CLOCK-UNITS | condition-name-1 }"; 2023: "I-O-CONTROL . [ [ apply-commit-clause] . ] [ [ { same-clause }… ]. ]". 2023 I-O-CONTROL keeps SAME [RECORD] AREA FOR file-names but has no RERUN clause, so programs using RERUN are no longer accepted. 2023 also adds APPLY COMMIT.
